repairSpecSchema.purpose: Every defect must carry a reproducible, machine-readable repair recipe before any fix begins. The recipe must tell a later AI/terminal exactly what source to use, what is locked, what may move, the target geometry/behavior, validation thresholds, rollback point, and forbidden strategies.

fieldRules.sourceAuthority: Must identify exact formal path(s) and SHA256 before image work; GitHub main is authority.
fieldRules.preserveExactly: Enumerate body/camera/stool/static regions that must not move or change. Never say only 'keep same'.
fieldRules.allowedChanges: Enumerate only regions/values allowed to change for this defect.
fieldRules.targetState: Describe the desired visible result and, where available, numeric contact/joint/timing targets.
fieldRules.editProcedure: Ordered steps, one operation per step, including candidate path and comparison baseline.
fieldRules.validation: Explicit PASS/FAIL checks with measurable thresholds where possible.
fieldRules.forbidden: Known bad strategies and unrelated changes prohibited for this issue.
fieldRules.rollback: Exact backup branch/commit and issue-local restore rule.
fieldRules.decisionLog: Why this repair was chosen over alternatives; update whenever evidence changes.
